top: A 9-year-old in Italy used an AI app to fake a photo of a python in a toilet. Police and firefighters searched for about 2 days.
comment: Pythons aren't native to Italy, which might have been the first clue.
topic_it: Bambino di 9 anni a Castelfidardo (Ancona) crea con l'AI la foto di un pitone nel water: ricerche di vigili del fuoco e Carabinieri forestali per circa 2 giorni, poi confessa
title: Police hunt fake python after 9-year-old uses AI #ai #police #fail
description:
A 9-year-old in Castelfidardo, Italy, used an AI app to fake a photo of a python in a toilet, and the search lasted about two days.
